title: SwarmSentinel
description: AI Swarm Dynamics Hackathon; ASP-inspired runtime policies + a multi-agent incident flight recorder

title: Problem: runaway coordination
description: Recursive delegation expands the number of active agents; Repeated consensus messages reinforce execution loops; Shared resources receive duplicate or excessive writes; Per-agent logs make system-level patterns hard to reconstruct

title: Approach: containment with evidence
description: Evaluate in-band calls before simulated execution; Observe shared-state activity outside the gateway; Detect coordination patterns across the interaction graph; Feed tripwire decisions back into runtime policy; Preserve a forensic record of actions and interventions

title: Design: runtime policy gateway
description: Admit agent identities and validate parent-span lineage; Default recursion-depth cap: 4 hops; Throttle the fifth matching intent and target across at least 3 agent IDs within 10 seconds; Default mock-write cap: 6 writes per target per 10 seconds; Deny tools outside the explicit mock allowlist

title: Design: flight recorder and dashboard
description: Capture actor, parent, span, intent, target, decision, and policy version; Distinguish allowed, throttled, dropped, and out-of-band observed events; Show executed interactions separately from blocked attempts; Replay the directed graph and enforcement feed through a timeline; Export Markdown reports and provenance-aware JSON traces

title: Architecture: processing pipeline
description: Simulator produces synthetic agent calls and shared-state observations; ASP gateway evaluates calls and emits structured telemetry; Sentinel builds the directed graph and detects coordination; Reporter summarizes lineage, affected resources, timeline, and interventions; React + Tailwind dashboard consumes the Python FastAPI engine

title: Architecture: tripwire feedback
description: Detect dense reciprocal communication, coordinated wiki edits, and excessive fan-out; Identify the agents involved in each detected pattern; Record a versioned revocation policy when feedback is enabled; Drop subsequent in-band calls from revoked agents and their descendants; Continue observing out-of-band activity; do not claim to undo it

title: Architecture: prototype boundaries
description: FastAPI + Pydantic validate requests; NetworkX analyzes interactions; NumPy supports deterministic intent fingerprints, not semantic embeddings; Tools and agent actions are synthetic mocks; no external execution; Policy and recorder are separate modules in one prototype process; Production hardening would require isolated enforcement and durable telemetry
